## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use in projections rooted on the later-starting interval to state it is partially overlapped from before — the inverse view of partial overlap.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting it directly when [`gmeow:intervalOverlaps`](gmeow-intervalOverlaps.md) already states the overlap; prefer the forward direction and read this as its inverse.

### How to use

- Let it follow by inversion from [`gmeow:intervalOverlaps`](gmeow-intervalOverlaps.md); NOT transitive (= [time:intervalOverlappedBy](http://www.w3.org/2006/time#intervalOverlappedBy)).
